title: ADPOCALYPSE
hint: The close button isn't helping.
desc: La X della pubblicità finta scappa: trascina tutto il banner fuori dallo schermo.
hints: The close button isn't helping.
You can move the entire ad.
Drag the banner out of the screen.
eggHow: Tocca la X finta esattamente 7 volte in 15 secondi prima di spostare il banner: arrivano pubblicità assurde e le X scioperano.

title: THE GLASS CAGE
hint: The glass has an opening.
desc: Ruota la campana di vetro con due dita finché l'apertura guarda il topo.
hints: The glass has an opening.
Look underneath it.
Rotate the dome until the exit faces the mouse.

title: THE INVISIBLE INK
hint: The paper isn't empty.
desc: Muovi il phon sul foglio senza fermarti per rivelare la mappa a inchiostro simpatico.
hints: The paper isn't empty.
Heat can reveal hidden ink.
Move the hair dryer across the sheet without stopping.

title: THE LAST DROP
hint: The bottle isn't completely empty.
desc: Inclina il telefono per portare l'ultima goccia dal tappo al foro, poi tocca per farla cadere sulla pianta.
hints: The bottle isn't completely empty.
Check the cap.
Tilt the phone to free the last drop.

title: TONI'S PERSONAL TRAINER
hint: Toni needs motivation.
desc: Guida Toni con il biscotto lungo il percorso senza farglielo mangiare: lo segue, salta i tre ostacoli e arriva al traguardo.
hints: Toni needs motivation.
Food works better than commands.
Lead him with the biscuit, but keep it away from his mouth.

title: THE ANGRY KEYBOARD
hint: Typing isn't working.
desc: Premere i tasti fa perdere lettere alla tastiera (5 pressioni = esplode): trascina le lettere O, P, E, N dai tasti nella casella della risposta, in ordine.
hints: Typing isn't working.
The keys themselves can move.
Drag O, P, E and N into the answer box.

title: THE COWARDLY DRAGON
hint: He needs a scare.
desc: Il drago ha paura del fuoco: trascina il sole dietro di lui, basso e vicino; l'ombra mostruosa sul muro lo spaventa e starnutisce una fiammata che brucia la barricata.
hints: He needs a scare.
His shadow can frighten him.
Move the sun to enlarge the dragon's shadow.

title: HIDDEN FREQUENCY
hint: The lock reacts to sound.
desc: Gira piano la manopola senza numeri guardando la vibrazione della serratura: fermati sulle tre frequenze giuste (casuali) finché le tre luci diventano verdi.
hints: The lock reacts to sound.
Watch the vibration indicator.
Tune until each of the three lights turns green.

title: THE CROOKED BRIDGE
hint: The bridge is badly aligned.
desc: Con un dito il ponte bascula: con due dita porta entrambe le estremità all'altezza delle piattaforme, poi tocca il topo che attraversa.
hints: The bridge is badly aligned.
Both ends can move.
Adjust the two ends at the same time.

title: THE FINAL WRONG ANSWER
hint: The correct answer may not be a door.
desc: Tre porte (3, 4, FISH) sono tutte sbagliate: trascina giù il cartello della domanda, che rivela un buco nel muro dove salta il topo.
hints: The correct answer may not be a door.
The question is covering something.
Move the question itself.

title: THE IMPATIENT CLOCK
hint: The hands won't stay still.
desc: Le lancette tornano indietro: tieni la lancetta dei minuti sul 12 con un dito, porta quella delle ore sul 12 con l'altro e stacca le dita insieme.
hints: The hands won't stay still.
Hold one while moving the other.
Use two fingers, then release them together.

title: THE FROZEN WATERFALL
hint: Sunlight can melt ice.
desc: Trascina la lente nella luce del sole e orientala finché il raggio scioglie la cascata ghiacciata (4 s): il topo prende la chiave.
hints: Sunlight can melt ice.
The lens can focus light.
Align the lens and hold the beam on the frozen waterfall.

title: THE FAKE CHECKPOINT
hint: The checkpoint isn't where it should be.
desc: Il checkpoint rispedisce l'eroe all'inizio: trascina la bandierina sopra la porta finale, poi premi GO.
hints: The checkpoint isn't where it should be.
Try moving the flag.
Put the checkpoint flag at the exit.

title: THE TWO-FINGER PIANIST
hint: These notes must sound together.
desc: Il leggio chiede tre accordi (C+E, D+A, F+B), ma il secondo tasto è timido e sparisce se toccato da solo: tieni premuto il primo e premi il secondo con un altro dito.
hints: These notes must sound together.
Use more than one finger.
Hold the first key and press the second simultaneously.

title: THE MOON THIEF
hint: Hide what he wants.
desc: Un ladro col retino vuole rubare la luna: trascinala dietro una nuvola, poi porta la nuvola fuori dallo schermo; il ladro non la trova e si arrende.
hints: Hide what he wants.
The clouds can conceal the moon.
Move the moon behind a cloud and take the cloud away.

title: BACK TO THE FUTURE
hint: The door hasn't been built yet.
desc: La porta esisterà solo il 29 ottobre: sfoglia il calendario-macchina del tempo con swipe verso l'alto fino al giorno esatto (se resti fermo torna indietro di un giorno).
hints: The door hasn't been built yet.
Time can move forward.
Swipe the calendar to the exact date on the sign.

title: THE THREE IDIOTS
hint: They aren't working together.
desc: Tre omini spingono un masso verso una buca, ma uno guarda dalla parte sbagliata: ruotalo con due dita finché tutti guardano la buca, poi tocca il fischietto.
hints: They aren't working together.
One of them is facing the wrong way.
Rotate the wrong character and blow the virtual whistle.

title: THE SHY STAR
hint: She's shy, but also vain.
desc: La stellina timida scappa se la tocchi: trascina lo specchio davanti alla nuvola dove si nasconde; si vede riflessa e, vanitosa, si accende.
hints: She's shy, but also vain.
Let her see herself.
Place the mirror where the star can see her reflection.

title: THE BROKEN INTERNET
hint: The connection is physically broken.
desc: NO INTERNET: metti i tre spezzoni di cavo tra computer e router facendo combaciare i connettori (un tocco li gira), poi premi CONNECT.
hints: The connection is physically broken.
Follow the cable.
Join the three cable segments in the correct order.

title: THE LAUGHING LOCK
hint: The lock won't stop laughing.
desc: Il lucchetto ride e la chiave rimbalza: tieni premuta la maniglia finché si stanca e sbadiglia, poi infila la chiave nella bocca aperta.
hints: The lock won't stop laughing.
Make it tired.
Hold the handle until it yawns, then insert the key.

title: THE FAKE BOSS
hint: The boss isn't what he seems.
desc: Schiva gli attacchi del boss gigante trascinando l'eroe, e intanto trascina via la sua barra della vita: senza sapere quanto è forte diventa un pupazzetto e scappa.
hints: The boss isn't what he seems.
His strength is displayed somewhere.
Remove the health bar.

title: THE GREAT ESCAPE
hint: There might be a way under the floor.
desc: Il topo è in cella e il gatto carceriere dorme a turni: mentre dorme porta il cucchiaino sulla piastrella smossa, che si alza e apre il tunnel verso l'uscita.
hints: There might be a way under the floor.
Look for a loose tile.
Use the spoon to lift the tile and open a tunnel.

title: THE IMPOSSIBLE SHOT
hint: A straight shot won't work.
desc: Fionda e canestro dietro due muretti sfalsati: serve un tiro di sponda con due rimbalzi (dopo 3 errori compare la traiettoria).
hints: A straight shot won't work.
Use the walls.
Aim for two rebounds before the basket.

title: THE ENDLESS STAIRCASE
hint: The top keeps moving away.
desc: La scala è infinita e la cima si allontana: trascina la parola TOP giù fino all'omino, la scala si accorcia e lui arriva in vetta.
hints: The top keeps moving away.
Maybe the goal can move closer.
Drag the word TOP down to the character.

title: TONI THE WERE-PUG
hint: Maybe the problem isn't Toni...
desc: La luna piena trasforma Toni in carlino mannaro: apri la scatola, prendi l'unico biscotto tondo e mettilo davanti alla luna finché la copre; la luce si spegne e Toni torna normale.
hints: Maybe the problem isn't Toni...
The full moon causes the transformation.
Cover the moon completely with the biscuit.

title: THE PERFECT PUMPKIN
hint: A carved pumpkin isn't enough for Halloween.
desc: Intaglia a mano libera due occhi, naso e bocca, accendi la candela con l'accendino, mettila nella zucca e, come ultima mossa, spegni la luce: la zucca si illumina, prende vita e sorride.
hints: A carved pumpkin isn't enough for Halloween.
It needs something to light it from the inside.
Light the candle, put it in the pumpkin and switch off the room light.

title: THE GHOST WHO CAN'T SCARE
hint: The ghost doesn't look very convincing.
desc: Il BOO non funziona: trascina via il lenzuolo (il fantasma resta invisibile) e mettilo sull'uomo, che si vede fantasma nello specchio e si spaventa.
hints: The ghost doesn't look very convincing.
Maybe the sheet could be useful to someone else.
Take the sheet off the ghost and put it on the man.

title: THE WITCH AND THE IMPOSSIBLE POTION
hint: All the ingredients seem wrong.
desc: Gli ingredienti danno solo reazioni comiche: trascina la parola BEAUTIFUL della frase nel calderone; pozione rosa, la strega diventa glamour (il nasone resta) e si fa un selfie.
hints: All the ingredients seem wrong.
The answer might already be right in front of your eyes.
Drag the word 'beautiful' into the cauldron.

title: THE VEGETARIAN ZOMBIE
hint: Maybe the problem isn't what he eats.
desc: Cervello e hamburger rifiutati, il broccolo mangiato ma non basta: tocca le lettere del fumetto finché resta BRAIN, poi trascina il fumetto su un broccolo.
hints: Maybe the problem isn't what he eats.
Read carefully what he's saying.
Turn BRAAAINS into BRAIN and drag the balloon onto the broccoli.

title: TRICK OR TREAT!
hint: The old lady recognises every visitor.
desc: Il campanello dà UN cioccolatino: componi un unico mostro (zombie davanti alla porta, Toni sotto i vestiti, zucca come testa, il fantasma avvolge tutti, la strega mette cappello e incantesimo) e suona. Easter egg: stacca il braccio dello zombie, daglielo a Toni, porta Toni sullo zerbino e suona con la mano.
hints: The old lady recognises every visitor.
Maybe the five monsters could show up as one.
Combine the five characters into one costume and ring the bell.
eggName: The Real Monster Is The Pug
eggHow: Stacca il braccio dello zombie, daglielo a Toni (lo tiene in bocca), porta Toni sullo zerbino davanti alla porta e trascina la mano dello zombie sul campanello.

title: THE FINGERPRINT THIEF
hint: Maybe the phone knows someone you don't.
desc: Unlock the phone without the PIN. PINs fail (fake 30 s lockout), the scanner rejects your finger, shaking: 'VIOLENCE IS NOT A PASSWORD.' The owner's photo dropped on the scanner only blinks the LED yellow: hold it there with a finger and gently tilt the phone to the left until the pictured fingertip is on the sensor for 1 s. 'FACE ID ENABLED' + giant face.
hints: Maybe the phone knows someone you don't.
The owner left something useful on the table.
The scanner needs to see the owner's finger, not yours.

title: WAKE UP, KITTY!
hint: Noise and light won't do it. Something tastier might... if it gets there.
desc: The cat sleeps through the alarm, the lamp and the feather, and the mouse steals the fish. Put the cheese in front of the mouse hole first (the mouse stays busy eating), then hold the fish under the cat's nose.
hints: Noise and light won't do it. Something tastier might... if it gets there.
The fish is the answer, but the mouse is faster. Give the mouse something better to do first.
Drag the cheese to the mouse hole, wait until the mouse takes it inside, then bring the fish right under the cat's nose.

title: THE FISH THAT IS AFRAID OF WATER
hint: Something smells fishy. And plasticky.
desc: The fish is an inflatable toy (it squeaks, valve on its back). Pump and emptying the bowl don't help. Spread the valve open with two fingers, turn the phone upside down so the fish floats with the valve above water, then blow into the mic for ~2 s (no mic: HOLD TO BLOW). 'YOU SAVED A PLASTIC FISH.'
hints: Something smells fishy. And plasticky.
Real fish don't usually squeak.
Find the valve. Open it. Give your fish some air.

title: THE NEIGHBOUR'S ALARM
hint: Maybe you're blaming the wrong clock.
desc: The ringing comes from the flat below, not the clock (tap, hold, pillow, shake don't stop it). Drag the heavy nightstand with two fingers to reveal a crack, tilt to roll the marble into it, then make one short loud sound: the shockwave bounces the marble onto the neighbour's SNOOZE. Then a rooster crows.
hints: Maybe you're blaming the wrong clock.
The floor seems unusually noisy.
Move the table. Something small might fit through that crack.

title: THE INVISIBLE PASSWORD
hint: Maybe the secret isn't behind the door.
desc: Codes fail ('0000': NICE TRY, FORGOT PASSWORD: SO DID WE). Tapping the door loosens a hinge: hold both hinges with two fingers and drag outward, then tilt right to swing the door. The back says 0000 (false lead); tilt further and the mirror shows the real code 8008. Behind the door: a broom closet.
hints: Maybe the secret isn't behind the door.
Security doors have hinges for a reason.
The answer is easier to read from another perspective.

title: THE INCOMPETENT MAGICIAN
hint: Magic works better without an audience of one.
desc: The magician ruins every trick (hat, boxes, wand). Cover his eyes with one finger and make a quiet sound: the rabbit points to a hidden trapdoor. Release (he rubs his eyes for a few seconds), drag the trapdoor open and drag the rabbit in. He bows; the rabbit shows 'WHAT AN IDIOT'.
hints: Magic works better without an audience of one.
The rabbit seems smarter than the magician.
Maybe the magician shouldn't see how the trick works.

title: THE PERFECT LIAR
hint: Perhaps the machine is lying too.
desc: Three statements can't be solved by logic; TEST gives contradictory results. The lie detector is installed upside down (logo and sticker upside down): hold both ends with two fingers and turn the phone upside down, release (all green), press TEST and make any sound: 'PLAYER — LIAR'. 'CASE CLOSED. SOMEHOW.'
hints: Perhaps the machine is lying too.
Look at how the detector was installed.
Turn the detector's world upside down before testing anyone.

title: THE RIGGED THREE-CARD GAME
hint: The dealer is very good at cheating.
desc: Every card is the Two of Spades. Hold two cards with two fingers and tilt: the free card slides off; under the middle one there is a crown-shaped ink stain. Drag it onto a card to make your own Queen and tap it. 'HEY! THAT'S CHEATING!' Hidden gag: tap the dealer's hat after the win (JOKER).
hints: The dealer is very good at cheating.
What if the Queen was never there?
Look under the cards. Perhaps you can make your own Queen.

title: ALMOST THERE
hint: Only one point is missing.
desc: Il contatore dice 99/100: trascina giù la barra "/" e tocca il puntino nascosto sotto per l'ultimo punto.
hints: Only one point is missing.
Look between the numbers.
Move the slash and tap the hidden dot.

title: TONI'S FINAL EXAM
hint: Toni isn't a normal student.
desc: L'esame finale di Toni: 2+2 = BISCUIT, trova il bicchiere col biscotto, poi trascina giù il diploma fino a lui. CERTIFIED GOOD BOY!
hints: Toni isn't a normal student.
Food is his answer to almost everything.
Choose BISCUIT, remember the biscuit and move the diploma toward Toni.

title: THE DARK ROOM
hint: Electricity is overrated.
desc: The room is pitch dark; your finger is a small flashlight. The switch clicks (no bulb), the lamp's cable is chewed by a mouse, the matches are wet. Clues: the clock says 2 PM, the radio talks about a sunny afternoon, a thin line of light at the curtain edge. Open the curtains (drag one panel sideways): it was daytime.
hints: Electricity is overrated.
What time is it, actually?
Light doesn't always come from a bulb. Check the window.

title: THE IMMORTAL CANDLE
hint: The wind doesn't seem to work.
desc: Blowing into the mic makes the flame grow ('KEEP GOING, I'M GROWING!'), the fan only bends it, the water just makes steam, one finger tickles it. Grab the flame with two fingers, pull it up off the wick and drag it to the top edge. It peeks back in and sticks its tongue out.
hints: The wind doesn't seem to work.
That flame looks strangely solid.
Maybe you should take the fire away instead of putting it out.

title: THE STUCK SNACK
hint: Kicking is not a payment method.
desc: The snack you just bought (B3) is stuck on the spiral and you have one coin. Kicking, shaking ('DO NOT ROCK THE MACHINE'), reaching into the flap and other slots don't help (the coin is always refunded). The same snack is in A3, right above: buy it, it falls and knocks B3 down. 'TWO FOR THE PRICE OF ONE.'
hints: Kicking is not a payment method.
Look at what's right above it.
Gravity can push too. Buy the same snack again, from the row above.

title: THE CAMERA-SHY BIRD
hint: This bird hates being the subject.
desc: The screen is a camera app. Aim at the bird and it stares at the lens and flies off; zoom: it covers its face; flash: tiny sunglasses. Clue: when the camera points away, it follows it. Flip to the selfie camera: the bird lands on your head and photobombs; shoot. 'THE BIRD IS IN THE PHOTO. YOU, HOWEVER, BLINKED.'
hints: This bird hates being the subject.
It loves being in photos. Just not the ones you aim at it.
Turn the camera around.

title: DON'T LET IT SINK
hint: That's a strange ocean.
desc: A toy boat with a hole slowly fills ('the sea'). Bucket, finger on the hole and tape only buy time; if it fills it sinks and pops back up (no fail). Clues: the horizon is a tub rim with tiles, a rubber duck, a chain in the corner. Pull the chain: the bathtub drains and the boat sits on the bottom. 'CAN'T SINK WITHOUT WATER.'
hints: That's a strange ocean.
Why is there a rubber duck at sea?
Every bathtub has a plug.

title: THE CROOKED PICTURE
hint: Are you sure it's the picture that's crooked?
desc: The picture looks crooked, but the whole room is tilted 12 degrees. Rotating, taping or nailing it fails. Clues: the water in the glass stays level with the screen, a marble rolls, the spirit level bubble is off. Tilt the phone by the room's angle for 1 s. 'THE PICTURE WAS FINE. YOU WERE CROOKED.'
hints: Are you sure it's the picture that's crooked?
Look at the water in the glass.
Don't fix the picture. Fix your point of view: tilt the phone.

title: THE UNSWATTABLE FLY
hint: Violence isn't working.
desc: The fly dodges every touch and the swatter (you squash the cake instead); the spray gets a gas mask. Clue: it keeps bonking against the closed window. Unlatch and open the window: it flies out and waves. 'IT JUST WANTED TO GO HOME.'
hints: Violence isn't working.
Listen to where it keeps bumping.
Maybe it wants to leave as much as you want it gone.

title: THE STUBBORN KETCHUP
hint: Shaking harder won't help.
desc: Tipping, shaking, squeezing, slapping and the knife get nothing out. Clue: a 'NEW!' sticker and a foil tab under the cap. Unscrew the cap, peel the seal, then pour: a ketchup smiley on the fries. 'IT WAS STILL SEALED.'
hints: Shaking harder won't help.
Brand new bottle. Look under the cap.
Open it properly first: cap off, then peel the seal.

title: THE CAT BURGLAR
hint: Some things in this house can climb better than you.
desc: The cookie jar is on a very high shelf: ladder too short, books topple, shaking does nothing, the cat slides back down like liquid. Switch on the laser pointer and lead the cat with the red dot from perch to perch up to the shelf: it pushes the jar off. Put the cushion under the shelf first, or the jar breaks (a new one appears). 'THE CAT DID IT. TECHNICALLY, SO DID YOU.'
hints: Some things in this house can climb better than you.
Cats love two things: red dots and pushing stuff off shelves.
Put something soft under the shelf, then lead the cat up with the laser.

title: THE LOST REMOTE
hint: Remotes are overrated.
desc: The TV shows 'PAINT DRYING LIVE'. Under the cushions: coins, a sock, a mouse; the remote is under the cat but has no batteries, and the clock's are dead too; unplugging is 'giving up'. The manual shows the side buttons: press CH+ on the side of the TV. 'TVs HAD BUTTONS ALL ALONG.'
hints: Remotes are overrated.
Read the manual. Seriously.
Look at the side of the TV.
